tools.description: FREE. Read the leads a search_areas job found, up to 100 per page. tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Search ONE city on the user's account and get the businesses back in the same call: 1 to 5 result pages from the city centre, about 20 per page. Use it when the user asks for a quick search, a page of results or one town; for a whole city or several, use search_areas, which finds several times more.

tools.name: unenroll_leads
tools.description: Remove leads from automatic enrichment. Free and immediate; a removed lead keeps its last reading and its history, and frees room in the plan.

tools.description: Two paid steps on one job. tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: SMTP-verify the business emails on saved leads through MillionVerifier. Costs 3 tokens for each address that comes back verified and nothing for any other answer; an address already verified for that lead within 90 days is not checked or charged again, and the run stops cleanly if the balance runs o

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll a background job started by search_areas, enrich_leads, enroll_leads (kind "enrich"), find_contacts or verify_emails. Pass the job id and its kind. Long jobs are normal: a grid search works through many map points, and enrichment fetches every website in the batch.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_search, search_areas, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, enrich_leads, verify_emails · Private data: preview_search, estimate_area_search, search_areas, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, estimate_list, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, enroll_leads, find_contacts, verify_emails · Public sink: get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, verify_emails · Destructive: estimate_area_search, search_areas, unenroll_leads, find_contacts, verify_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_search, search_areas, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, enrich_leads, verify_emails · Private data: preview_search, estimate_area_search, search_areas, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, estimate_list, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, enroll_leads, find_contacts, verify_emails · Public sink: get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, verify_emails · Destructive: estimate_area_search, search_areas, unenroll_leads, find_contacts, verify_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
